description: A single filled area whose points are joined by straight segments instead of a smoothed curve.
overview: One series filled under straight line segments instead of a smoothed curve. Prefer it to the default when smoothing would suggest values between points that were never measured.
usage: Replace `chartData`, update each `dataKey` to your field names and rename the `chartConfig` entry to set the label and color. Everything else matches the default area chart.
notes: Keyboard users can focus the plot and step through the months with the arrow keys.
